title: SIDESTORY: COME CATASTROPHES OR WAKES OF VULTURES OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: COME CATASTROPHES OR WAKES OF VULTURES OPEN
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 9, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- Phase 1 Anemic Platform
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 2, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2 Black Landship
DURATION: March 26, 2024, 16:00 – April 2, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Prize Exchange Office]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Prize Exchange Office] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Coldshot], BSW Safehouse Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Shoddy Fuel, etc.
[Shack by the Tower]
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 9, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Shoddy Fuel by clearing event stages and completing [Prize Exchange Office] missions. Shoddy Fuel can be used to redeem items from [Shack by the Tower].
REWARD: Coldshot's token, BSW Safehouse Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CLANK LIBERTY
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 2, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Clank Liberty], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Jessica the Liberated
★★★★★: Almond / Aosta

Note : This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game
★★★★★★: Jessica the Liberated
★★★★★: Almond
★★★★★: Coldshot
Note :
- Operator Coldshot is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- Jessica the Liberated and Almond will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after April 2, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
Jessica the Liberated, Almond and Coldshot will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 [ARKNIGHTS x CHINESE NATIONAL GEOGRAPHY] COLLAB OUTFITS NOW AVAILABLE
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 9, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- CROSSOVER Collection - Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia for Ling
- CROSSOVER Collection - Wine-flushed is Woods of Rime for Qiubai
- CROSSOVER Collection - Rainforest, Me, Rainbow for Franka
Note :
[Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the collab outfits.
05 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
Duration : March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 2, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Epoque Collection - Book Reader for Mountain
- Epoque Collection - Temperament for Akafuyu
06 NEW FURNITURE SET BSW SAFEHOUSE
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, BSW Safehouse will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event rewards and redeem in Shack by the Tower (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
07 CHIP PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMTIED TIME
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 2, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
DEFENDER CHIP PACK
CONTENTS: Defender Dualchip *4, Defender Chip *5, Skill Summary - 3 *45, Skill Summary - 2 *25, Skill Summary - 1 *10
08 SIGHTSEEING PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMTIED TIME
DURATION: March 19, 2024, 10:00 – April 2, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Sightseeing Pack
CONTENTS: Orundum *600, Icon: 'Destination' *1
09 VIEW FROM ABOVE COLLABORATION EVENT
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 2 days to receive generous rewards, including: Event Exclusive Furniture, Materials, Furniture Part, etc.
Day 1: Stone Beach Pop-Up Book Pile *1, Furniture Part*500, Tactical Battle Record *20
Day 2: Poplar on the Sands Windowsill *1, LMD *50000, Strategic Battle Record *30
Please stay tuned for more information!
